title: Manager Job at Future Moves Recruitment Agency
content:
Future Moves Recruitment Agency (FMR Agency) - Our client in the Furniture industry, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Manager 

Job Location: Lekki phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary


	We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Manager to oversee daily operations, lead a high-performing team, and ensure the smooth and efficient running of the business.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Oversee and coordinate daily business operations.
	Supervise, mentor, and manage staff performance.
	Ensure operational efficiency and compliance with company policies.
	Monitor performance, prepare reports, and implement improvements.
	Resolve operational challenges and maintain excellent customer service.
	Drive the achievement of business goals and objectives.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in a managerial role.
	Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent organizational and decision-making abilities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
	Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.


Salary
N200,000 monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.    

    

        Click here to Apply

        Flash Delivery (Flash Express) is a technology-driven logistics and courier company that provides fast, reliable, and secure parcel delivery services for individuals, e-commerce businesses, and corporate clients. The company focuses on last-mile delivery, parcel pickup, warehousing, fulfillment, and supply chain solutions to ensure timely movement of goods and customer satisfaction.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Human Resource Officer 

Job Location: Ilupeju, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

            
    




	The Human Resource Officer oversees company's workforce and manages all major part of employee lifecycle
	While responsible for recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, attendance monitoring, documentation and ensuring compliancewith human resource policies and processes


Key Duties and Responsibilities


	Recruitment and Hiring: Attracting, interviewing, and selecting qualified candidates to fill open positions.
	Employee Relations: Resolving workplace conflicts, mediating disputes, and supporting positive staff communication.
	Training and Development: Organizing programs to help workers improve their skills and grow in their careers.
	Performance Management: Overseeing appraisals, setting goals, and tracking employee output.
	Compensation and Benefits: Managing pay structures, insurance, and worker perks.
	Policy and Compliance: Ensuring company rules match local labor laws and maintaining safe working conditions


Qualifications


	B.Sc. or HND in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Public Administration, or a related field.
	2 - 4 years of experience in HR and administrative functions.
	Experience in logistics, courier, transportation, or service-based operations is an added advantage.
	Professional HR certification (CIPM, HRPL, or related certification) is an advantage


Essential Skills Needed:


	Organization: Handling multiple tasks and keeping precise worker records
	Problem-Solving: Fair conflict resolution and smart decision-making.
	Leadership: Guiding teams and advising other company leaders on staffing choices.
	Communication: Clear speaking and active listening to handle staff concerns.


Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Ticketing, Reservation & Tour Package Officer Job at Bozinda Travels and Tours Limited




        
    

        
         BozindaTravels and Tours Limited is a leading IATA-accredited travel management company in Nigeria, providing comprehensive travel solutions including airline ticketing, corporate travel management, visa assistance, and tour packages. 

As part of our growth strategy, we are seeking competent, customer-focused, and detail-oriented staff to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Ticketing, Reservation & Tour Package Officer

Job Location: Abuja
Employment type: Full-time
Slots: 2

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The successful candidate will be responsible for handling airline reservations and ticketing, providing excellent customer service, preparing travel quotations and itineraries and supporting the company’s tour package unit.


Key Responsibilities
Ticketing/Reservation Duties:


	Handle flight reservations, ticket issuance, rebooking, cancellations and refunds. 
	Sourcing, calculating and quoting basic and complex airfares for the purpose of making reservations, confirmation and subsequent issue of airline ticket as may be requested and agreed to by our corporate and individual clients.
	Search and compare flight schedules, fares and availability using GDS platforms such as Amadeus, Sabre and Travel Port (Galileo/Worldspan)
	 Articulate in writing a daily transaction summary detailing all ticket requests and the status of all transactions.
	Follow Airline fare rules, ticketing policies and industry procedures.
	Provide timely and professional responses to customer enquiries.
	Foster relationships with leading tour industries for cost-effective packages.
	Explore and secure tailored tour packages to meet customer needs.


Requirements
Educational Qualifications:


	Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree (B.Sc./HND) in a relevant field
	Minimum of Second-Class Lower/Lower Credit


Experience Requirements:


	2–3 years of relevant experience in airline ticketing, reservations and travel agency.
	Hands-on experience with Amadeus or other GDS platforms.
	Strong knowledge of airline fare rules, routes and ticketing procedures.


Required Skills:


	Proficiency in Amadeus GDS and airline reservation procedures.
	Excellent Customer service skills
	Good computer and Microsoft Office (Excel) skills
	High level of accuracy and attention to detail
	Strong organisational and time management skills
	Good written and verbal communication skills
	Ability to work accurately under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Good negotiation and persuasion abilities


Personal Attributes:


	Integrity and high ethical standards
	Ability to work with minimal supervision
	Strong problem-solving skills
	Team player with a proactive attitude.


Remuneration


	Salary: Competitive and in line with industry standards.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using "Application for Ticketing, Reservation & Tour Package Officer" as the subject of the mail.

Medical Manager II (HMO Experienced) Job at MetroHealth HMO Limited




        
    

        
        MetroHealth HMO Limited is a licensed Health Maintenance Organization based in Lagos, Nigeria, established to provide accessible and affordable healthcare services. It offers health insurance plans for individuals, families, and corporate organizations. The company operates a wide network of accredited hospitals and healthcare providers nationwide. Its services include outpatient and inpatient care, maternity, emergency services, and telemedicine support. MetroHealth HMO leverages technology to improve healthcare access, efficiency, and customer experience. 
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Medical Manager II (HMO Experienced)
Job Location: Lagos Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	MetroHealth HMO Limited is seeking a qualified and experienced Medical Doctor to join its team as Medical Manager II.


Requirements


	MBBS/MBChB or equivalent medical qualification.
	Minimum of 5 years post-qualification experience in an HMO.
	Valid practising licence and registration with the Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN).
	Good knowledge of HMO operations, utilization management, medical claims, referrals, and healthcare provider management.
	Excellent communication, analytical, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced healthcare environment.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application to: [email protected] using "MEDICAL MANAGER II (HMO EXPERIENCED)" as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
